cohort: The study included 210 post-cesarean section patients presenting with morbidly adherent placenta.
finding: The frequency of hysterectomy in morbidly adherent placenta among post-cesarean section women was 79.04%.
mod_finding: The study reported that 79.04% of post-cesarean section patients with morbidly adherent placenta underwent hysterectomy, highlighting a high frequency of this outcome in this specific birth mode context.
